integrity: Symbolic unrestricted argument supported but not replaced by two finite checker scripts. Literature searches are not a proof of historical priority. No independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Relative classification only, in the pure adjacency language and without counting. Not a global FO-defining-width claim among all finite graphs; does not cover arbitrary matching deletions or unbalanced bicliques. The cited 2018 paper studies word representation rather than first-order logic.
title: Sharp fixed-variable spectrum for crown graphs and balanced bicliques
